notes.title: Free Standalone Non-VR Version - Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=w6b7xsb_aJM;full][/previewyoutube]

You may have noticed after a bit of a hiatus, I'm back in the IronWolf dev saddle. I hope to bring new quality of life features and possibly new content if there's still enough interest in the game.

To help revive the community and to improve peoples chances of being able to play with their friends, I'm going to release a free non-vr (desktop only) standalone edition of the game.

More info here: IronWolf Free Non-VR Edition

The Free Non-VR edition will include all of the standard missions, including the randomly generated encounters. Players of the Free standalone edition will be able to create and join games with players of the full VR version but not Open World games.

The free standalone version will not include any elements of the Open World gameplay, submarine upgrades or leaderboards.

I've got a few things I need to tidy up before this can be released, but I'll endeavour to get it out as soon as I can.

notes.title: Early Access 1.11.0.0 - Horizon & Frigate Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28060826/764de95f54f2896ca7fe9b0ad0fe5262b615f2ab.jpg

The feature highlights for this release are we’re now simulating the curvature of the earth to help bring the action closer to the player, we’ve added a new Frigate enemy type and we've added a new game mechanic to the snorkel which will now flood the engine room if it's not stowed properly when traveling below periscope depth. We’ve also added lots of other features including quality of life and balance changes. 

Full changelog below:

 Simulated Horizon with curvature of the earth
 Applied realistic ships speeds to submarine and enemies
 Reduced the engagement zone size to keep the pace of the game consistent with realistic ship speeds
 Added Frigate to open world as primary convoy defense vessel with 3 inch guns and depth charges
 Up to 6 frigates will be assigned to defend a convoy based on the Open World threat level, however frigates only require 2 torpedoes to sink.
 Upgraded destroyer guns to 6 inch
 Added Hedgehog weapon to some destroyers
 New destroyer model
 Updated battleship damage zones to split damage between port and starboard sides
 Updated battleship behaviour to expose strongest side to the player
 Removed hedgehog weapon from battleship and retired lone battleship mission as this vessel now only spawns with supporting destroyers
 Improved enemy gun targeting
 Applied realistic projectile speeds and arc to enemy shells
 Added Smoke effect to Frigate, Destroyers and Battleship funnels
 Added a menu item to the hand display to allow the host to turn assists on/off during a mission
 Added identification and range labels for ships inside the periscope view, this can be toggled in general settings.
 Added snorkel overflow outlet that floods the engine room when the snorkel is not stowed when submerged if the engine room assist is off.
 Added Depth Gauge to engine room.
 Auto Rudder now automatically orientates to fast travel direction.
 Each player is now assigned a different green, red, blue or white helmet and the helmet colour is reflected on the players name in the add friend and kick player menus on the hand display.
 Increased effectiveness of hydroplane and reduced forward velocity penalty when using the hydroplane.
 Added Knuckles/Index controller button bindings.
 Periscope start position is now facing the bow
 Fixed a bug where the Telescope could cause the user to lose their vision inside the submarine.
 Fixed a bug where map markers would not update correctly with the waypoint assist off.

notes.title: Horizons & Frigate Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
From community feedback we’ve been looking at improving the surface experience of the submarine and enemy ships. To achieve this we are simulating the curvature of the earth so that you’ll be able to see distant ships coming over the horizon towards you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28060826/4b7c2d2699a386fead7503f43b91232efb168c77.jpg

Previously to keep the pace of engagements exciting in VR we decided to make the submarine and enemy vessels travel twice as fast as they would in the real world, this had the trade-off of making the submarine feel faster than it should on the surface, this was particularly noticeable when turning. Adding horizons allows us to bring the action closer to the submarine without relying on tricks like pop-in or fog and at the same time we can use realistic speeds/physics on the submarine and enemy ships without compromising on the pace of the engagement.

As part of this update we’ll also be adding a new enemy frigate into the open world. These vessels are weaker than destroyers but can work in larger numbers to hunt submarines. We’ve also made alterations to destroyers so that some of them can now use hedgehog launchers as well as depth charges. These variant destroyers will also be added to the open world.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28060826/45f9fb241a2cc4528b92abb6f2d6da6ea3fb433d.png

notes.title: Early Access 1.9.0.0: Open World Test Map 1 Release
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28060826/420c4765373cda455a335738e7be44837b79575e.png

We’ve just released the first set of open world features for both single and multiplayer. This update adds an open world map that allows players to travel the wider oceans by using a pen to plot courses directly on the map.

While navigating the open world players will need to evade or engage enemy air and military patrols while hunting down convoys. In this release we’ve added limits to the submarine fuel and number of torpedos providing new tactical decisions. The submarine will need to return to port to refill its fuel and stock up on torpedos. Additionally, if a submarine engages in shallow waters they’ll be able to evade enemy sonars while the deep ocean provides no such cover.

The world map is scored differently to the other missions in that it’s based on what and how much you’re able to sink/destroy rather than how quickly you complete the mission. You’ll earn more points for taking out stronger targets and more points in harder locations, such as in deeper water or in a heavily militarised zone. The medal cabinet has been extended to display the highest score of each open world player that’s in your game.
 
 Tech information

Much of the technology behind the open world map is procedural, this means that we’ll be able to alter the map rapidly as we progress. We plan to add new maps as we receive feedback and add new features to the open world.

We’ve written an entirely new game server platform for the open world simulation, which has been the largest and most complex task of IronWolf's development. This was necessary to provide us with a flexible base that will enable us to deliver content updates more frequently and gives us the tooling required to accomplish our long term visions for IronWolf.

Our new platform will be able to provide the ability to allow multiple multicrew controlled submarines and other vehicle types to coexist and interact in the same world for PvE and PvP, but we have more content and gameplay we want to deliver for the core IronWolf experience before we're able to progress those goals.

 What comes next

In the coming weeks we’ll be adding in some more features to the open world, in no particular order we’re going to be working on:


Adding mines 
Day & night cycle
End of engagement summary
Leaderboard system
Quest System
New open world maps
Resupply for rebreather, welder and deck guns.
Allied shipping and military to add larger scale naval battles


In the longer term there are some larger features we’ll be working on in the background, that will appear in the coming months. The most important of which will be a new enemy damage model with additional enemy types.

We’re really excited to get this update into the communities hands and we’re equally excited for new content and gameplay opportunities that this early version of the open world will allow us to add.

notes.title: Early Access 1.6.0.0 Engine Room Update
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zKTkLUX-_Uk&feature=youtu.be

Hey guys, we’re excited to be releasing our first development pass of the engine room.

The engine room adds optional resource management gameplay for larger teams to enjoy and some cool machinery to interact with.

When the engine assist is turned off, the available battery power and compressed air is limited so that you’ll need to manage these resources carefully throughout a mission. On the surface, you can use the diesel generators to recharge the battery and use the compressor to replenish your compressed air. A snorkel has been added so that the diesel generators can pull in fresh air when you’re at periscope depth.

We’ve also added a cosy sleeping quarters which is visible from the periscope room.

notes.title: Early Access 1.5.0.3: Inventory, Oxygen Supply and Torpedo Targeting Update in Main Game Now
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2T6ktIpLLJU&feature=youtu.be

Hi everyone, 

We’ve moved the Inventory and Oxygen supply changes from beta into the main game now. This adds our new inventory system and an oxygen supply item so players can use the pumps for longer periods of time. The welder can also be stored in inventory slot. We’ve also added guidance controls for torpedos so players can improve their chance of hitting enemies. 

We’ve also added a death sequence when you run out of oxygen either in the submarine or while wearing an empty oxygen supply item.

Changelog:

Replaced straight running torpedoes with radio guided torpedoes.
Revamped Torpedo Data Computer (TDC) to include axis controls for live torpedo heading.
Added re-calculating sound effect when using the axis controls.
Added Empty, Reloading and Ready status displays for torpedo tubes on TDC.
Added locked target Heading, Distance and Speed to TDC display.
Added two inventory slots on player avatar.
Added per player limited 60 second oxygen supply item
Added death by asphyxiation when you run out of oxygen supply.
Fixed an issue where the camera shake wouldn’t trigger when taking damage.

notes.title: Early Access 1.4.0.6: Damage Control Update Out of Beta
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/8YtDRvO.jpg

https://youtu.be/Zva7HmgbZTY

Thanks you to everyone who tested and gave us feedback on the new damage control and graphics in the beta branch. We’ve now put these features into the main game so they are available to all players.

To fix leaks, pick up the welder which is located on the control room door. Use the trigger to activate the welder and hold it near to the source of the leak. If you see sparks, you are fixing the leak, continue welding until the leak stops. Water can be removed by using the bilge pump. In multi-player, someone can use the bilge pump to buy more time for the person using the welder. We’ve balanced single-player so that it is not necessary to pump and weld at the same time.

We've also fixed an issue where random missions could de-sync.

notes.title: Early Access 1.4.0.0: Damage Control Update in Beta
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/8YtDRvO.jpg

https://youtu.be/Zva7HmgbZTY

We’ve just completed our first development cycle of the damage control mechanic and this is now available in a public beta branch that can be selected from the Beta settings in Steam. We will be adding a tutorial for this damage control before we release it to the main branch.

To fix leaks, pick up the welder which is located on the control room door. Use the trigger to activate the welder and hold it near to the source of the leak. If you see sparks, you are fixing the leak, continue welding until the leak stops. Water can be removed by using the bilge pump. In multi-player, someone can use the bilge pump to buy more time for the person using the welder. We’ve balanced single-player so that it is not necessary to pump and weld at the same time.

Water leaks no longer fix themselves.
Added small and large leaks that fill the submarine at different rates.
Added a welder to fix water leaks.
Water no longer drains out of the submarine by itself.
Added manual bilge pumps to remove water from inside the submarine.
Improved visibility through internal water with custom refractive shader so that bilge pumps can be located when the submarine is flooded.
Individual players can now drown on their own in the submarine, once you are dead, you can no longer control the submarine. The game ends when all players are dead.
Implemented custom graphics pipeline:

Reduced CPU load
Multiple optimized GGX pixel lights.
Single pass

Replaced internal doors so that we can utilise this space for additional items and instruments.
Multiple Texture improvements.
Networking Optimizations.
General bug fixes.

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hey Guys, this is just a quick update to make the hydrophone role more interesting, tweak the submarine physics and fix some bugs.

Changelog

When the waypoint assist is turned off, the hydrophone user must now track the target to get up-to-date map marker positions for the enemy. Out of date map markers will continue to move with the last observed velocity until the hydrophone has received new readings.
Setting the Engine Order telegraph will now rapidly set the engine throttle to the desired state, giving more immediate power in the required direction.
The submarine will now experience less drag when travelling on the surface vs submerged.
Using the hydroplane will now increase drag of the submarine.
Improved rudder and turning physics model for the submarine.
Improved buoyancy gauge stabilization.
Fixed a bug where torpedoes could fire in the wrong direction
Fixed a bug that allowed the player to open the conning tower hatch before being fully surfaced.
Reduced network bandwidth usage.

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.0.0 Major Update - Battleship and more
notes.notes:
New Enemy: The Battleship, heavily armed and armoured.

https://i.imgur.com/9FcUHEL.gif


Battleship has a long range Hedgehog Mortar that fires between 1500m and 3000m, so get in close.
Battleship can fire torpedoes at you from its broadside, dive quickly as torpedos can not track you below periscope depth (~15m).
Battleship deck guns do a lot of damage, recommended not to surface.
Battleship takes approximately 10 torpedos to kill.
Added 2 new missions featuring the Battleship.
Extended random missions to occasionally spawn Battleships.


Completely Reworked Enemy Detection Model.

https://i.imgur.com/hHrCaVN.gif


Pulsing circles on the map show the area where enemies can detect you.
Enemies inside this area will be able to see or hear you and know your location.
The area is large when you’re surfaced, larger still if the periscope is fully extended.
The following items affect the detection area when submerged: Submarine Speed, Submarine Depth and Periscope height above water
Firing a torpedo or the deck gun will spike your detection area for a short period of time.
Enemy sonar pulses are now displayed on the map as a translucent blue wave. If you can hear the sonar ping, the enemy has detected you.


Official Oculus support and locomotion option for players without Roomscale


We’ve added an unobtrusive locomotion mechanic where you can use the Vive track pad or Oculus Joystick to make small adjustments to your location and orientation inside the submarine. You can turn this on/off from the settings menu.
Left control will let you do a small hop, forward, back, left and right.
Right control will rotate you 90 degrees.
Grip button crouches.


Misc.


Improved enemy ships physics simulation.
Improved AI steering and engine control.
Added settings to the main menu that allow players to change locomotion type.
Replaced enemy ship alarm with automatic incoming torpedo alarm.
Reduced destroyer deck gun damage.
Reduced damage of AA flak gun against enemy ships and forts.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Early Access 1.2.0.0 Update - Local Multi Crew and Underwater Terrain
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/gSlBxEm.gif

Hey Guys,

It wasn’t officially on our road-map, but we hope you’ll approve of this update. We’ve added an experimental local desktop control for the control room so that someone can play using the monitor and mouse at the same time as someone using the VR headset. When you’re using desktop controls, you can switch between your controls and what the VR player can see by pressing the spacebar.

Some points to note:

Local controls can be turned on/off in the menu
Local controls are available in single player mode
Local controls are only available to the host in multiplayer mode

We’ve had a lot of fun with this in testing, let us know what you think.

We have now added underwater terrain which can be used to avoid Sonar if you have landed on or are very close to the sea bed. Use the Depth Under Keel Gauge (next to the depth gauge) to judge your descent and use the underwater terrain display (above the rudder) to find a suitable location to land. Carefully!

Other changes:


You now take less damage in the orange depth zone.
Some texture improvements.
Minor network stability fixes.


Next up we’re going to be adding a new enemy ship type along with extra missions.

notes.title: Early Access 1.1.1.1 Update - Group Remake and Hot Join Rooms
notes.notes:
Hey guys, based on a lot of feedback from the community, this update is focused on improving the multiplayer lobby experience.

Change log:

 - Once a mission has ended, the host can remake the room with the same group of players.
 - You no longer need two players to start a game in a multiplayer room, you can start a game while waiting for players to join you.
 - Players can now join rooms with games in progress and will be able to participate in the next mission.
 - The host can abort the mission at any time from the menu (accessed by the menu button on the controller) to return to mission select with the same multiplayer group.
 - We have removed region select as rooms are now automatically created on the server with the lowest latency for your location.
 - Rooms from all regions are now displayed in the same list, the region of the room is visible next to the room name.

notes.title: Early Access 1.1.0 Major Update - Torpedo Room
notes.notes:
https://giant.gfycat.com/SaltyEssentialIriomotecat.gif

This updates includes the Torpedo Room which is accessed by the hatch on the floor of the control room. From the torpedo room you’ll be able to manually load the torpedoes much quicker than the previous automatic reloading routine.

All 4 torpedo tubes can be manually reloaded in the minimum room scale space of 2m x 1.5m, this was a challenge as we wanted the torpedoes to be large and imposing and also have enough room to fully open and close all 4 torpedo tube doors.

Once the torpedoes are in position, you have to manually push them in with your hands, we scale the movement, use a bit of inertia and use haptics to make the torpedoes feel like heavy objects. The faster you work, the faster you can reload the torpedo. You can even use two hands to load two torpedoes at once.

https://giant.gfycat.com/OrnateFaintAntelope.gif

There is a torpedo loading assist that is enabled by default in single player and disabled by default in multiplayer, this will load the torpedoes at the same speed as they did before the update. If you go into the torpedo room with the assist on, you can watch the torpedoes loading themselves, but you can also interrupt the process and load the torpedoes manually.

We did experiment with using alternative mechanisms for moving the torpedo such as a hand crank and chain pulling but the additional space required for these components to operate was too cramped within the minimum room scale space.

Don’t forget to lock the hatch before you flood the torpedo tube, or you’ll end up flooding the whole room!

https://giant.gfycat.com/LividSophisticatedDeinonychus.gif

We’re looking forward to people playing this and giving feedback.

Other changes:

 - Added a volume slider for voice chat
 - Renamed Auto Rudder to Set Heading
 - Minor texture improvements

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.2 update.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We've been made aware of some networking stability issues and this is our first attempt to fix this. 

We've replaced the hydrophone assist with a waypoint assist. Disabling the waypoint assist removes the waypoint marker so you have to manually use the hydrophone to find your targets. 

Change log:
 - It's now possible to get to the front of the conning tower by using a small gate from the flak gun.
 - Replaced hydrophone assist with waypoint assist. Turn off the waypoints and you'll need to use the hydrophone to find targets.
 - Improved Hydrophone sounds.
 - Fixed diesel and electric engine sounds being the wrong way around.
 - It's now possible to use the ship alarm.
 - Player hands are now easier to see in dark areas.
 - Made it easier to raise the periscope by increasing the handle interaction range.
 - Players are no longer rotated 90 degrees when using the hatch to the flak gun.
 - Reduced network sensitivity to timeouts which may help prevent players from being disconnected.
 - Fixed an issue where some peripheral devices could interfere with the in game menu.
